Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! David Warner and Aaron Finch will open the batting for Australia. Chamika Karunaratne will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Sri Lanka have posted a below-par total here, and they face an uphill task from here. The pitch is assisting the spinners, and we know dangerous their spin attack is. Can they do something special here? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

The full innings of Sri Lanka only belonged to one man out there, Chamika Karunaratne! If it was not for him, the hosts would have been bundled out for below a hundred. After losing the openers, and Dinesh Chandimal in quick succession, Charith Asalanka and Kusal Mendis did try to steady the ship. They put together just over 20 runs and were in the process of doing some damage work. But unfortunately, both were dismissed in the same over and it all went downhill for them from there on. From him beings 56 for 3 they fell to 85 for 8 within the next 10 overs. Most of the wickets for Sri Lanka were due to poor shot selections, and run outs. Post that, Chamika Karunaratne and Pramod Madushan stitched a partnership of 58 and guided Sri Lanka over 140. Chamika Karunaratne was the aggressor in that knock, he notched his maiden half-ton, while Pramod Madushan played the perfect role of the second fiddle. Chamika Karunaratne scored a total of 75 runs and took Sri Lanka to 160. He has given the bowlers something to bowl at now.

After being asked to bowl first, Australia started off really well. Josh Hazlewood made sure they got the early inroads and put Sri Lanka under the pump early in the innings. The other bowlers capitalized on the start and grabbed wickets at regular intervals. They took 8 wickets for 85 runs and put Sri Lanka under immense pressure. However, post that the 9th wicket partnership started to frustrate them. As result, Sri Lanka crossed the 140-mark. Nevertheless, it's still been an exhilarating bowling show from the visitors and they have a golden opportunity here to end the ODI series with a victory.

It's been an exemplary recovery from Sri Lanka! The way wickets were tumbling, a target of 100 was looking tough for the hosts. But they have done a fine job to reach the 160-mark and set a respectable total. All, thanks to Chamika Karunaratne. He has given Sri Lanka something to fight with. Australia though will be a tad disappointed giving away those runs towards the end. Still, they would be the happier side going into the break.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, Chamika Karunaratne mistimes one and it brings his end and also the end of the Sri Lankan innings. Pat Cummins digs it in short but takes the pace off the ball and angles it onto the body. Karunaratne tries to take it on and swings across the line. Karunaratne gets a top edge and the ball is skied around the leg gully region. The keeper Alex Carey calls for it early and settles under it nicely to take the catch. A brilliant, brilliant innings from Karunaratne comes to an end. Pat Cummins gets his second wicket and Sri Lanka have been bundled out for 160!
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Pat Cummins is back on!
On a length and around off, this is played towards cover-point. 14 runs came off that over!
Flighted ball, on off, Maheesh Theekshana strides forward and defends it out.
Around middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Full and straight, this is wristed through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Short and around off, Chamika Karunaratne gets down on one knee and pulls it all the way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Marnus Labuschagne is receiving some real stick here.
WIDE! Marnus Labuschagne tries to push it wider but spills it beyond the tramline outside off.
SIX! Tossed up, on off stump and turning away. Chamika Karunaratne backs away and frees his arms to launch it back over the bowler's head for a maximum. Sri Lanka have gone past 150!
An attempted slower bumper, around leg stump. Maheesh Theekshana sits under it and no wide is called.
WIDE! Cameron Green comes from 'round the wicket for the final delivery, trying to attack the batter's ribs but spills it down leg. Wided.
This is banged in short and over the stumps, Maheesh Theekshana ducks under it.
Just a bit too straight from Cameron Green and Theekshana flicks it past the man at short leg for a couple of runs.
Slightly fuller and slanted into off, solidly kept out by Theekshana.
Length ball, around off. Maheesh Theekshana taps it towards cover-point.
Maheesh Theekshana is the last man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Finally, Australia have managed to break this stand! It was starting to frustrate them. A gritty knock from Pramod Madushan comes to an end. A fuller ball, around middle, tad slower in pace. Pramod Madushan looks to drive this down the ground but ends up chipping it back to the bowler. Cameron Green takes a good return catch. Sri Lanka are now 9 down!
Back of a length, outside off. Pramod Madushan pushes off the back foot towards over for a single. He retains the strike!
Another shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Chamika Karunaratne knocks it towards long on and takes a single.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, a leg-break, shorter ball. Chamika Karunaratne tries to cut this away but he misses.
Loopy ball, very full now, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne digs it out back to the bowler.
Full now, quick as well, on middle. Pramod Madushan gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Pramod Madushan cuts it towards point.
Powerplay 3! Australia will be allowed to place 5 fielders now outside the inner circle.
On the pads, this is tucked away 'round the corner for one. 10 runs come off that over, a good one for Sri Lanka.

DROPPED! The skipper, Aaron Finch has put it down and how costly could this prove to be for Australia? Slower delivery, angling into the pads. Chamika Karunaratne gives the charge and hits it hard and flat towards long on. Finch comes in from the deep but the ball dips on him at the last moment. Finch gets both hands on it but grasses it. Just the single then.
Slower length ball, on off. Karunaratne blocks it out.
Full and on the pads, this is flicked away past square leg for a couple of runs. Sri Lanka now edging closer to the 150-run mark.
FOUR! Hammered! Full and straight, Chamika Karunaratne advances and muscles it over the man at mid on for a boundary. The 50-run partnership is up between these two.

Starts off with a length ball on off, Karunaratne swings at it and lofts it in front of square on the leg side. Matthew Kuhnemann runs around to his left from the square leg fence and keeps it down to two.
Cameron Green is brought into the attack.
Flatter delivery, on off. Madushan goes back to blocking. Maiden!

A bit of a cheeky attempt from Pramod Madushan but it doesn't come off. This is looped up, full and around off. Madushan pre-meditates and attempts the reverse paddle but misses the shot by quite a fair distance.
Quicker this time, around middle. Madushan blocks it out.
A touch fuller and turning away a long way from around off, Madushan looks to drive but doesn't connect yet again.
Shorter and quicker, close to the off pole and turning away. Pramod Madushan backs away to cut but misses.
On a nagging length, outside off, Madushan looks to block but is beaten.
On a good length, on off, Karunaratne blocks it out.

FOUR! Yet another half-tracker from Pat Cummins and Chamika Karunaratne has dispatched it with ease. Short ball, on off and with no real pace behind it. Karunaratne pulls it between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary and that will be a half-century for him. Superb knock under pressure from Karunaratne.
This is slanted in from outside off, Karunaratne pushes it towards mid on.
Length again, on off, Karunaratne keeps it out on the off side.

Pushing for two and they get it with ease. Good length, around off, Karunaratne gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket. Karunaratne comes back for a risky second run but the throw is a bit too wide for the keeper to reach.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Pat Cummins, a half-tracker going down leg. Chamika Karunaratne shuffles and pulls it fine, beating the man at fine leg for a boundary.
Flatter delivery, on off, Pramod Madushan looks to cut but gets an inisde edge towards short fine leg. No run is taken.
A bit quicker and turning away off a length around off. Madushan is beaten past the outside edge.
On a nagging length, around off and the ball turns away square this time. Madushan plays inside the line of the ball.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Pramod Madushan looks for the expansive cover drive but gets a thick outside edge towards short third man.
This is very full and around off, Karunaratne squeezes it out towards cover-point for one.
On a shorter length and outside off, turning away a long way. Karunaratne manages to fend it away towards the gully region.
On a good length, outside off, Karunaratne plays it towards cover-point for a single.

WIDE! Chamika Karunaratne moves inside the crease and throws Pat Cummins off his course. Karunaratne goes well past the off stump and Cummins tries to follow him with a short ball but it is just too short and too wide.
Length, around off, solidly blocked off by Karunaratne.
On a good length and around off, Karunaratne gets an inside edge onto the pads as the ball rolls towards covers.
A slower bumper now, outside off and around head height. Chamika Karunaratne looks to hook but is undone by the lack of pace.
This is a bit fuller and slanted into off, Karunaratne drives it towards mid on.
A length ball, around the top of off. Karunaratne defends it out on the off side.
Short again, around off. Pramod Madushan defends it out off the back foot.
Quicker, shorter and outside off this time. Pramod Madushan looks to cut this away but he misses.
Fuller ball, outside off, loopy ball. Chamika Karunaratne drives it towards deep cover. Three runs taken!
Tosses up ball, full, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne sweeps it down to deep square leg for a brace
Another leg-break, shorter ball, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne stays back and tries to cut this away, but the ball goes off the under edge onto the deck and back to the keeper.
Beaten! Tosses this one up, full in length, spinning away outside off. Chamika Karunaratne prods forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Marnus Labuschagne (2-0-13-0) is back on.
Pat Cummins drops it short now from 'round the wicket, around middle and leg. Pramod Madushan ducks underneath it.
On a length again, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne shuffles across and dabs it towards square leg. Single taken!
Angling in now, darting it on the pads, length ball. Chamika Karunaratne flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Slower this time, at 115 clicks, on a length, and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne cuts it to the fielder at point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Chamika Karunaratne blocks it towards point.
A length ball, around the ooff pole. Chamika Karunaratne shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Matthew Kuhnemann is done with his spell and Pat Cummins (3-1-7-1) comes on to replace him.
Single off the last ball! Full, around middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker, now, flatter, and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne hangs back and tries to cut this away but he gets an under edge back to the keeper.
Another pitched-up delivery, around middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne lunges and defends it out towards the leg side.
Full, on the pads. Chamika Karunaratne presses forward and clips it towards square leg.
Tossed up delivery, full, around off. Chamika Karunaratne looks to flick this one but he misses.
A fuller ball from 'round the wicket, around off. Chamika Karunaratne defends it out.

DRINKS! Well, at 85/8 Sri Lanka were reeling and seemed to be bundled out inside the 100-run mark but it has been a fighting stand between Chamika Karunaratne and debutant Pramod Madushan. Australia will be slightly disappointed but they still seem to have things under control and will look to finish off the innings at the earlieast. The question here is, can Sri Lanka somehow manage to get to 150 and give themselves an outside chance? We'll find out soon.
Beaten now! Touch short this time, quick and outside off. Pramod Madushan looks to defend this but misses.
Floated delivery, full, around off. Pramod Madushan drives it towards mid off.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Pramod Madushan presses forward and blocks it out.
Slower this time, loopy ball, around off. Pramod Madushan defends it towards cover.
Much quicker on this occasion, this one comes in with the arm, around middle. Pramod Madushan leans forward and tries to block this but he gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Tosses this up, full in length, around off. Pramod Madushan drives to the fielder at mid off.
Short ball now, around middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne stays in his crease and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A full toss, down the leg side. Pramod Madushan pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a single.

A shorter one this occasion, fuller ball, outside off, quick as well. Pramod Madushan tries to cut this away but he misses. Alex Carey collects the ball and removes the bails off. The umpires check for stumping there. The replays show that Pramod Madushan foot is well grounded.
Glenn Maxwell goes back to over the wicket, full ball, around off. Pramod Madushan once again drives it to cover.
A fuller ball from 'round the wicket, outside off. Pramod Madushan drives and find the fielder at cover.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne knocks it down to long on for a single.
Glenn Maxwell comes back to bowl.
Another solid defensive shot from Pramod Madushan. On middle, kept out and that will be a maiden over for Matthew Kuhnemann.
This is fuller and drifted into the pads, Madushan backs away looking to drive but gets pinged on the back leg.
Quicker this time and angled into middle, Madushan makes yet another block.
On off this time, Madushan keeps it out on the off side.
On middle again and Pramod Madushan keeps it out.
Flighted, on middle, kept out by Madushan.
FOUR! Tossed up, full and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne hangs deep and thumps it over mid on for a boundary.
A slight mix-up in the middle but no harm is done. Down the leg side, paddled away towards short fine leg.
Tossed up, full and on off, blocked out by Karunaratne.
Short and around off, this is cut away past cover-point for a single. The 100 is up for Sri Lanka!
This is pushed a bit wider and the ball turns away from the batter, left alone by Madushan.
FOUR! A bit dragged down from Marnus Labuschagne and down the leg side, Pramod Madushan pulls it hard and into the backward square leg fence for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Once more Chamika Karunaratne survives and yet another good decision by the umpire on field. Matthew Kuhnemann drifts this one full and around leg stump. Karunaratne looks to make a bit of room and drive but gets beaten in flight. The ball crashes into the pads and there is a huge appeal from the bowler. It is turned down but Finch reviews it again. No spike on UltraEdge and Ball Tracking shows that the ball didn't turn enough, just about clipping leg stump and the decision stays as the umpire's call.

Review! Australia have taken yet another review for an LBW decision against Chamika Karunaratne! No Bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates it is the umpire's call on wickets hitting! The on-field decision stands.
Floated up, on the pads, Karunaratne sweeps it to the right of the man at short fine leg.
Fuller and on middle, Madushan flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Around off, this is pushed through mid off for a single.

This is looped up, on a length and around leg stump. Chamika Karunaratne looks to paddle sweep but misses and gets hit on the arm. Appeal for an LBW decision from the bowler and the keeper but it is not given. Aaron Finch decides to take the review though. The third umpire first checks the UltraEdge and finds that no bat is involved. Ball Tracking is then checked and the ball did straighten enough but height is the issue as the ball is going well over middle stump. NOT OUT!
Flighted delivery, on off. Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Beaten! Lovely flight on this one, on a nagging length around off and turning away sharply. Pramod Madushan puts a stride forward but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Short and wide, turning further away. Pramod Madushan backs away to cut but can't reach the ball.
Loopy delivery, outside off, Madushan plays inside the line of the ball.
Tossed up, around off and turning away sharply. Madushan looks to defend but is well beaten.
FOUR! Short and around off, Madushan goes back and across to cut it past point for a boundary. Top shot!
Floats it up around off, Pramod Madushan drives it towards cover-point.
Marnus Labuschagne comes into the attack.
Two taken! Back of a length, around off. Karunaratne plays it off the back foot and to the right of the man on the backward point fence. Karunaratne comes back for the second with ease.
Short ball, on leg stump. Pramod Madushan swivel-pulls it down to fine leg for one and gets off the mark in ODI cricket.
Around the top of off stump, Madushan hangs back and taps it towards point.
Full and straight, at 132 clicks. Madushan pushes it towards mid on.
A well-directed short ball, at a good height and over the batter's shoulders. Pramod Madushan looks to take it on but is well beaten.
Length ball, angling into middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne nudges it towards mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Tosses it up, around middle. Pramod Madushan blocks it out watchfully.
Loopy ball, full in length, around middle. Pramod Madushan blocks it out off the front foot.
Slower through the air, full, spinning away, around off. Pramod Madushan presses forward and defends it out.
Fuller ball, spinning away, outside off. Pramod Madushan gets beaten while trying to defend that one.
Pramod Madushan, the debutant is in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bullseye! What a throw this from Marnus Labuschagne! Sri Lanka have now lost their eighth wicket. Jeffrey Vandersay's resistance comes to an end! A shorter ball, quicker, this one comes in with the arm. Chamika Karunaratne stays in his crease, and taps it towards point setting off for a quick single. Marnus Labuschagne runs towards the ball, collects the ball from his right hand, and scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. Jeffrey Vandersay put in a dive there, but he was nowhere near.

Is that a run-out? It's a direct hit from Marnus Labuschagne and he seems to have got his man. The third umpire is checking the replay and Jeffrey Vandersay seems to be short of his crease. The decision on the big screen is OUT!
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Chamika Karunaratne sweeps and finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Full in length, around middle and off. Jeffrey Vandersay pushes it back to the bowler. Back-to-back maidens for Josh Hazlewood!
On a length, outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay leaves it alone.
Josh Hazlewood hit the deck hard now, serves a short ball, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay looks to slash this one but he misses.
Pitched up this time, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Slower, shorter, outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay blocks it towards cover.
FOUR! Good shot by Chamika Karunaratne! Very full now, tosses it up as well, around off. Chamika Karunaratne drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Chamika Karunaratne leans forward and defends it out.
Turn and bounce! A fuller ball, this one lands around off and spins away sharply. Chamika Karunaratne leaves that alone.
Tad quicker, around the off pole, full in length. Chamika Karunaratne prods forward and tries to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto his pads.
Full again, around middle and off. Chamika Karunaratne drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Tosses it up, full, this one lands around middle and spins away a tad. Chamika Karunaratne presses forward and taps it towards point.
Very full on this occasion, around middle and off. Jeffrey Vandersay drives it back to the bowler. A maiden over for Josh Hazlewood!
Back of a length, outside off, at 131 clicks. Jeffrey Vandersay punches it off the back foot to the fielder at cover.
Josh Hazlewood drops it short now, outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay sways away from it.
Good-length delivery, outside off, at 131 clicks. Jeffrey Vandersay pushes it towards the fielder at cover off the back foot.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he misses.
Full in length, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay blocks it out.
Josh Hazlewood (4-1-18-2) is back into the attack.
Tosses it up, on the pads, full in length. Chamika Karunaratne flicks it towards square leg.
Full, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay knocks it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, loopy one, around middle. Jeffrey Vandersay presses forward and defends it out.
Full again, tosses it up, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay drives and finds the fielder at short cover.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay blocks it out.
Tosses this one up, very full, around off. Jeffrey Vandersay drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Around middle, this is pushed to the right of the bowler as Glenn Maxwell makes a diving stop.
Tossed up, outside off. Karunaratne gets a big stride forward and looks to get inside the line of the ball to sweep but misses and gets hit full on the pads.
On a length, around off, this is punched off the back foot towards cover-point for one.
Sent back and rightly so. Flatter and around off, tapped away towards short cover. Karunaratne looks for one but is sent back by his partner.
Shorter in length, around off, Karunaratne dabs it down towards point for a quick run.
FOUR! Powerfully struck! Quicker and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne gets down and sweeps it hard with the turn into the square leg fence for a boundary.
Flatter this time, sliding into the pads. Jeffrey Vandersay nudges it onto the leg side.
Uppish but in the gap! Looped up, on a shorter length and turning away. Jeffrey Vandersay plays it uppishly off the back foot but through the vacant cover region for a couple of runs.
Full, on middle and leg, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery, on middle. Jeffrey Vandersay pushes it towards mid on.
Jeffrey Vandersay was ball watching there and fortunately for him, the ball went past mid off. This is tossed up, around off, Karunaratne drives it past mid off and down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Looped up, full and on middle. Chamika Karunaratne drills it right back past the bowler and picks up a boundary at long on.
Risky single again but they make it through. Around middle and leg, Karunaratne plays it with soft hands towards square leg and sets off for a quick single.
Flatter this time and on off, Karunaratne keeps it out on the off side.
On middle, blocked off by Karunaratne.
This is speared into middle, Karunaratne keeps it out.

FOUR! Gets it fine! Fuller and going down leg, Chamika Karunaratne shows all his stumps as he looks to sweep but ends up getting a faint edge that goes in between the keeper and leg slip. The ball runs away to the fence for a boundary.

Stifled appeal from the bowler but nothing is given. On a length, turning into middle and leg, Chamika Karunaratne looks to nudge it down but the ball goes off the pads and straight into the clutches of the man at leg slip.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes to the crease.

OUT! Cleaned up! Matthew Kuhnemann with a lovely piece of bowling to get rid of the Sri Lankan captain and Australia are all over the opposition at the moment. Nice bit of flight and drifted around the pads. Dasun Shanaka backs away looking to drive through covers but gets beaten in flight. The ball tuns away after pitching and goes off the pads to crash into the leg stump. Matthew Kuhnemann has his second wicket and Sri Lanka have now lost 4 wickets for 16 runs!
Full and on the pads, this is swept away down to fine leg for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! That's inexperience shown by Dunith Wellalage and Sri Lanka tumbling down in a hurry here. Flighted, on a length and around middle. Wellalage dances down the track and looks to force the lofted shot over mid-wicket. Wellalage gets nowhere near the pitch of the ball and ends up lifting it around the mid-wicket region. Pat Cummins from mid on runs to his left and takes a solid catch. Matthew Kuhnemann gets a wicket for his hard work and Australia in total command at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c Pat Cummins b Matthew Kuhnemann

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely shot to get off the mark! Tossed up, full and outside off. Dunith Wellalage drives it beautifully through extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Around off, this is pushed away towards cover for a quick single. A slight mix-up again but no harm done.
Tossed up, on off, Shanaka drives it towards cover.

DRINKS! Australia are all over Sri Lanka at the moment. Just when Sri Lanka were trying to build a partnership, a mix-up between the batters cost them a wicket, and then a hit-wicket from saw Kusal Mendis saw the end of him as well. All of a sudden there are two new batters at the crease. Sri Lanka will need a partnership here, while Australia will look to capitalize on this! Also, Dunith Wellalage comes to the crease.

OUT! HIT WICKET! Lightning strikes twice in two balls and both set batters have now been sent back to the pavilion. This is short again from Glenn Maxwell, around off. Kusal Mendis gets down on one knee and goes deep in his crease to pull it away. Mendis does so but in the process, his back leg makes contact with the stumps and the bail is dislodged. The Aussies are celebrating while the third umpire has a look at it and he is satisfied. An unfortunate way to get dismissed but Maxwell will claim the wicket and Australia on top of proceedings now as Sri Lanka lose their fifth wicket.
Dasun Shanaka the skipper of Sri Lanka comes to the crease.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and it has brought a wicket for Australia. Short and around off, Charith Asalanka rocks back and punches it well in front of square on the off side. The batters look for two and it seems to be quite easy but Matthew Kuhnemann attacks the ball well running to his left from the cover fence and throws it towards the bowler. Asalanka is halfway through when Kusal Mendis sends him back and Glenn Maxwell throws the ball back onto the stumps. Asalanka is nowhere in the frame and has to walk back.
Shorter delivery, around middle and the ball holds a bit on the surface. Mendis pulls it in front of square on the leg side for one.
On a nagging length, on middle. Mendis goes on the back foot to play it towards mid-wicket.
This is angled into middle and leg, Charith Asalanka works it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Maxwell comes from around the wicket and loops it up on leg stump. Mendis pushes it through mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Charith Asalanka blocks it out. Tidy over from Mitchell Marsh. 3 runs off his first over!

Good running again! Tad shorter, around middle. Charith Asalanka pulls it towards deep square leg. They run the fast one first and come back for the second one as well. Aaron Finch does not look happy there! A better throw was needed!
Slower now, very full, outside off. Charith Asalanka drives it to the fielder at cover.
Fuller now, around off. Charith Asalanka presses forward and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Charith Asalanka blocks it out from within his crease.
Mitchell Marsh begins with a length delivery, outside off. Kusal Mendis steers it down to third man for a single.
Mitchell Marsh is now brought into the attack.

Good running! Full, slower through the air, around middle and leg. Charith Asalanka presses forward and flicks it in the vacant square leg region. They take two runs! There was a throw at the bowler's end but Kusal Mendis was well in. A direct hit would have probably done the trick here!
Outside off, short in length. Kusal Mendis dabs it towards point and rotates the strike.
Quicker, shorter, around middle. Kusal Mendis hangs back and defends it towards the leg side.
Loopy one, slower through the air, outside off. Charith Asalanka prods forward and drives it past backward point. Single taken!
Full from 'round the wicket now, tosses it up, around off. Charith Asalanka lunges forward and defends it out.
Back of a length, spinning in, around middle and off. Kusal Mendis pushes it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Angling in again, around off, length ball, Charith Asalanka once again taps it towards point. A maiden from Pat Cummins!
Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka stays in his crease and defends it out.
This is good from Pat Cummins! Offering no room to the batter! Tad shorter tight line as well, around off. Charith Asalanka hops and defends it out.
Angling in around the off pole, length delivery again. Charith Asalanka taps it towards point.
Touch fuller, around off. Charith Asalanka defends it towards the fielder at cover.

Beaten! Lovely delivery by Pat Cummins! On a length, shaping away a tad, outside off. Charith Asalanka stays in his crease and tries to guide this one towards third man but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
This one comes in with the arm, flatter and on the pads. Charith Asalanka flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punshied! Glenn Maxwell drops it short now, width on offer as well. Charith Asalanka stays back and slashes this past point for a boundary.
Tosses it up again, full, around off. Charith Asalanka lunges forward and defends it out.
Beaten! Loopy one now, full, spinning away from the left-hander, outside off. Charith Asalanka presses forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short again, turning in, around middle. Kusal Mendis uses the depth of the crease and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker, spinning in, around middle and leg. Kusal Mendis flicks it towards the fielder at square leg.
Shaping away, outside off, tad shorter. Charith Asalanka leaves it alone.
Pat Cummins drops it short, around middle. Charith Asalanka pulls it over md-wicket. The fielder from deep square leg cuts it out. Two taken!

Pitched up again, on the pads. Kusal Mendis dabs it towards mid on and scampers across to the other end. Aaron Finch collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the keeper's end but Charith Asalanka was well in.
Angling in, fuller ball, around middle. Kusal Mendis taps it towards the fielder at mid-wicket. No run taken there!
On a length, outside off, at 129 clicks, shaping away. Kusal Mendis gets beaten as he tries to cut this away.
Back of a length, around the off pole. Kusal Mendis hangs back and taps it towards point.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders are allowed to be placed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.

Nicely tossed up, around off. Asalanka looks for the sweep yet again but only manages to get the toe end of the bat on it. Just the single then of the over and Sri Lanka are 35/3 at the end of the first Powerplay.
This is flatter and angled into the pads, Charith Asalanka goes for the big sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On off, Charith Asalanka keeps it out.
Flatter delivery, on middle and leg. Mendis works it off the back foot behind square on the leg side for one. With that, the sun is out as well and is shining brightly.
On a shorter length and around middle, Mendis flicks it towards square leg.
Flighted, around off. Kusal Mendis looks to block it off the back foot but is beaten past the outside edge.
Glenn Maxwell comes back to bowl. He has gone for 6 runs in his two overs so far.
A dot to end a successful first over from Pat Cummins. This is fuller and angled across the left-hander, Charith Asalanka lets it through to the keeper.
Length ball, around middle, this is flicked away towards mid-wicket.
Charith Asalanka walks out to bat at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! Aaron Finch with a sharp catch and Pat Cummins strikes in his very first over! This is pitched up, around middle. Dinesh Chandimal looks to drive on the up but it isn't that sort of a pitch and Chandimal ends up punching it uppishly but with decent timing. Aaron Finch at mid on moves swiftly to his left and pouches it. Cummins gets the breakthrough and Sri Lanka are three down inside the first Powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, over off. Chandimal pushes it back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Short and with a hint of width on offer, Dinesh Chandimal absolutely pounces on it. This is slapped off the back foot through cover-point for a boundary.
Starts off with a short ball, around off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to play it off the back foot but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Pat Cummins comes into the attack. He replaces Josh Hazlewood.
Beaten! Nicely flighted, outside off. The ball grips and turns away sharply, beating the batter comprehensively.
Slower and shorter, outside and turning away. Mendis waits for it but can't get it through the cover region.
On off, this is pushed towards cover.
FOUR! Brilliant use of the crease from Kusal Mendis and he is motoring along nicely. Quicker and just a bit shorter on off, Mendis rocks back and with fast hands cuts it past point for a boundary.
Around off, this is pushed with the turn towards cover for a quick single.
On a length, on off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to drive it but gets an inside edge onto the leg side.
Length, top of the off stump line. Kusal Mendis defends this one from inside his crease. 10 runs off that over, a good one for Sri Lanka.
On a good length, over middle. Mendis hops back to defend it onto the deck.
FOUR! Wow! Full and outside off, Kusal Mendis leans forward and times this one exquisitely through extra cover for another boundary.
Short of a length and on leg stump, Mendis turns it off his hips through square leg for a couple of runs.
Better from Hazlewood. Around the top of off and angling in, Mendis nudges it down towards short leg.
FOUR! A gentle loosener from Josh Hazlewood and he is duly punished. Half-volley, outside off, creamed through extra cover by Kusal Mendis for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off and turning away. Chandimal drives it with the spin towards covers.
This one comes in with the arm. Flatter delivery, angling into the pads. Dinesh Chandimal looks to turn it leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Around off, kept out on the off side by Chandimal.
Nicely flighted, on a length and on middle. Dinesh Chandimal looks to block but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg.
A touch shorter and on off, turning away. Mendis rocks back and slaps it through wide mid off for a single.
Starts off with a flighted ball on middle. Kusal Mendis prods forward to block it out.
Matthew Kuhnemann is into the attack now.
Full now, angling in again, on the pads. Kusal Mendis pushes it towards mid on for a single. End of another successful over from Josh Hazlewood!
Shaping away, outside off, length ball. Kusal Mendis leaves it alone.
Angling in, on the pads, length delivery. Dinesh Chandimal flicks it towards square leg and takes a single. He gets off the mark straightaway!
Dinesh Chandimal is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in two overs for Josh Hazlewood! What a start this is for Australia! Josh Hazlewood now sends back the other opener, Danushka Gunathilaka as well. Tad short again, around middle and off. Danushka Gunathilaka dances down the track makes room and tries to slap this over mid off. But the ball goes off the top half of the bat and goes straight to Aaron Finch at mid off who takes an easy catch. Sri Lanka in trouble early on!
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Width on offer now, short in length. Kusal Mendis steers it down to third man for a single.
Touch fuller, around middle and off. Kusal Mendis pushes it back to the bowler.

A huge appeal for LBW, but turned down! A fullish ball, this one lands around the leg pole, and turns towards middle. Danushka Gunathilaka tries to block this but he gets hit on his back pad. The replay shows that it was pitching outside leg.
Shorter again, spinning in, around middle. Kusal Mendis gets behind the line of the ball and works it away towards mid-wicket. Single taken!
Outside off, back of a length. Kusal Mendis stays in his crease and cuts it towards point.
Tad quicker on this occasion, darting it on the pads. Danushka Gunathilaka works it away towards square leg and takes a single.
Spinning away, short in length, around middle and off. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it towards point off the back foot.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka presses forward and blocks it out solidly.
On a length, outside off. Kusal Mendis shoulders his arms at it. A wicket-maiden for Josh Hazlewood! Terrific over for Australia!
Much fuller now, around middle. Kusal Mendis defends it out solidly.
Good-length delivery, outside off, at 130 clicks. Kusal Mendis once again lets that go through to the keeper.
Outside off again, tad shorter. Kusal Mendis offers no shot.
On a length, outside off. Kusal Mendis leaves it alone.
Kusal Mendis walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Early breakthrough for Australia! Josh Hazlewood draws first blood and he gets rid of Pathum Nissanka. A big wicket for the visitors. A length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka leans forward, and tries to poke this one towards the off side. But the ball goes off the outside edge towards the keeper. Alex Carey grabs it safely. A lazy shot from Pathum Nissanka has cost him his wicket here!
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, spinning away, tad shorter. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to have a poke at it but he misses.
A low full toss, around middle. Pathum Nissanka strokes it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, full, around middle and leg. Danushka Gunathilaka knocks it towards long off for a single.
Pitched up again, around middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka flicks it towards square leg and takes a single. Pathum Nissanka gets off the mark that!
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka leans and works it away to mid-wicket.
Glenn Maxwell begins with a shorter ball, spinning away, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka taps it off the back foot towards cover-point and runs across to the other end.
Glenn Maxwell to operate with the other new ball.
Outside off, length delivery. Danushka Gunathilaka knocks it towards mid off and takes a quick single. 5 runs off the first over!

FOUR! Sri Lanka and Danushka Gunathilaka are underway in style! Full again, wide of off this time. Danushka Gunathilaka gets down on knee, drives this one away from his body and over cover for a boundary.
On a length now, around middle. Danushka Gunathilaka stays back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full again, swinging down leg. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Pitches it up now, around middle, at 131 clicks. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Josh Hazlewood begins with a shortish ball, outside off. Danushka Gunathilaka hangs back and blocks it out towards the off side.

We are ready for play! It is a sea of yellow in the stadium as most of the spectators have taken the initiative to show the touring side their gratitude for coming to their country in such difficult circumstances, a beautiful gesture from the fans. The umpires and the players are out in the middle with Danushka Gunathilaka and Pathum Nissanka all set to open the innings for Sri Lanka. Josh Hazlewood has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Aaron Finch the captain of Australia says they were looking to bat first as well, but they want to improve on their chasing and have an opportunity to do it in this final game. Informs that Josh Inglis makes his debut and he comes in for Travis Head.

Dasun Shanaka the skipper of Sri Lanka says that they will have a bat first. Adds that the wicket looks decent and the ball will spin in the evening. Mentions that in different games they had different match-winners which is good and he is happy with the team. Informs that they have made three changes to the side.

Russel Arnold is pitchside. He says that the pitch is a fresh one and it is very dry with a lot of cracks around. Mentions that spinners will come into play but batters can still score runs if they are patient. Adds that the captain winning the toss will look to bat first for sure.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Mitchell Marsh, Josh Inglis (On ODI debut) (In for Travis Head), Marnus Labuschagne, Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Cameron Green, Pat Cummins, Matthew Kuhnemann, Josh Hazlewood.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka (In for Niroshan Dickwella), Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dinesh Chandimal (In for Dhananjaya de Silva), Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Dunith Wellalage, Pramod Madushan (On debut) (In for Wanindu Hasaranga), Jeffrey Vandersay, Maheesh Theekshana.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

The weather in Colombo has remained kind thus far, and let’s hope the rain stays away from this one as well. Sri Lanka have already clinched the series and hence this is kind of a dead rubber, but we can still expect a cracker of a contest. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Sri Lanka were under the pump while defending a target of 258. But their army of spinners displayed their magic and demolished Australia’s batting lineup. Eventually, the game did go down the wire and Dasun Shanaka held his nerve and guided his side home. We can expect Sri Lanka to make a few changes since they have already secured the ODI series.
